title: Which firms reduce energy/emissions; environmental-goods imports

source.request:
Siapa yang reduce energy use and emisi?
Lebih ke determinan motivasi apa yg membuat firms respond to climate commitment.. 
Tambahan: Siapa yang impor lebih banyak (EGs) environment goods list (termasuk solar panel, dll)
source.notes: Bukan kausal, tp mengetahui firms mana yg respond thd climate and motivasinya apa

question: Which factories reduce energy use and emissions, and which import environmental goods?
rationale: Describe within-factory patterns without turning reverse causality, output expansion, or a noisy baseline into a claim about motivation.
scope: Full exact Word row, interpreted through repository minimum checks and current owner full-plan ning/full-row acceptance gates. All analysis below is planned, not executed.
unit_of_analysis: Verified establishment-year and true adjacent calendar-year pair; firm-product-year for the environmental-goods branch.

target_estimands.name: Primary requested target
target_estimands.formula: r^E_it = ln(E_i,t-1)-ln(E_it); r^C_it = ln(C_i,t-1)-ln(C_it); r_it = alpha_i + lambda_t + X_i,t-1 beta + u_it

symbols.i: a verified establishment, never a row-number or artificial linkage
symbols.V: value added deflated with a certified appropriate price index; any single-output-deflator approximation is named
symbols.Y: gross output deflated with its certified output-price index
symbols.E: scope-defined verified physical energy in GJ; incomplete observed subtotals are separately named
symbols.C: scope-defined verified CO2 in metric tonnes; not automatically all greenhouse gases
symbols.L: workers under an annually verified employment definition
symbols.X: predetermined measured covariates declared for the particular design
symbols.g: verified treatment-entry cohort in calendar years
symbols.S: a verified trade, ownership, industry, or survival state; unknown is retained as unknown
symbols.r: annual reduction; positive means the physical measure fell
symbols.alpha_i: plant effect in the reduction model

target_estimands.interpretation: Positive r means a reduction. beta is an association between a predetermined characteristic and the annual reduction within the observed eligible population.
target_estimands.limits: Lagged variables and fixed effects do not resolve reverse causality. Intensity can improve through a growing denominator with unchanged physical energy or emissions. Broad solar-related imports do not establish solar installation.
